This integration is behind (as in older version of) the standalone MAA, so some things might be outdated or not work properly; WiP

MaaReclamationAlgorithm.help: Enter Reclamation once manually so the save or stage entrance exists

Enable.name: Enable Task
Enable.help:
Join this task to scheduler.
Task commission, research, reward are force to enable.

NextRun.name: Next Run
NextRun.help:
Updated automatically after completing the task to set next scheduled run, typically not manually modified
However you can force immediate scheduling if you clear this text field

SuccessInterval.name: Success Interval
SuccessInterval.help: After successful, postpone next run for X minutes

FailureInterval.name: Failure Interval
FailureInterval.help: After failure, postpone next run for X minutes

ServerUpdate.name: Server Update
ServerUpdate.help: Series of server refresh time(s) as to when this task will next run, this is automatically converted to respective time zone, generally do not need to modify

WhenTaskQueueEmpty.name: When All Tasks Are Completed
WhenTaskQueueEmpty.help:
Action to take after all MAA tasks are done, while waiting for the next run
Stay at main page: do nothing, MAA usually leaves the game at the main page
Close game: close the game client via MAA to reduce CPU usage while waiting, the game will be restarted automatically before the next task
Close emulator: close the emulator after closing the game, CPU and memory usage is the lowest while waiting, the emulator will be restarted automatically before the next task

Serial.name: Serial
Serial.help: check your emulators serial number, usually somewhere like 'details'

CustomPackageName.name: Custom package name (optional)
CustomPackageName.help:
Leave empty to use the official package name of the selected server.
Only fill this in when the game is a modified / repackaged client whose package name differs from the official one, e.g. com.hypergryph.arknightt
Package name only, do not include the activity (no "/").
Restart this ALAS instance for the change to take effect.

TouchMethod.name: Touch Mode
TouchMethod.help: in terms of compatibility usually minitouch>>>adb, while maatouch should be even better but is experimental

DeploymentWithPause.name: Deployment with Pause
DeploymentWithPause.help: does the deployment pause trick, experimental

_info.name: Send recorded stats
_info.help: sends records to 3rd party sites (material drops, recruitment, banner pull etc.), might require respective account

PenguinID.name: PenguinID
PenguinID.help: ID for your Penguin Stats account

AutoUpdateResource.name: Auto update task resources
AutoUpdateResource.help:
Check and download incremental resources (tasks.json, e.g. event stages) before running MAA tasks.
Very small (~15 KB), and a failure will not affect tasks

UpdatePackage.name: Auto update MAA
UpdatePackage.help:
Check for a new MaaCore and download the full package (~300 MB)
MaaCore cannot be replaced while in use, the update is installed on the next Alas startup

VersionType.name: Update channel
VersionType.help:
Stable, Beta or Nightly
MaaCore and resources of a channel must match each other, usually no need to change

Enable.name: Enable assist startup
Enable.help:
Disabled by default, only needed when the client shows the dynamic island panel
Skipped when no dynamic island is detected, later tasks are not affected
The client must be 1280x720

MedicineTactics.help: no use = don't use any; expiring = only the yellow ones; run out= red ones

Medicine.help: use sanity packs if not enough sanity; WiP

Stone.name: Originium

Times.name: Repeat
Times.help: how often this fight should be done, e. g. you want to run 1-7 from 135 Sanity to lowest amount, using in-game repeat stages (= series setting) you would want to set series 5 and repeat 4 (6*5*4= 120) and then reconfigure

Series.name: Series
Series.help:
Arknights native repeat stage option.
"DISABLE" does not adjust the in-game repeat count setting. If there is not enough sanity to complete the current in-game setting, the task will end directly.
"AUTO" automatically identifies the maximum repeat count for the level, maintaining the maximum repeat count without overflowing sanity.
"1-6" perform the selected number of repetitions. If the current sanity is not enough to complete the set number (such as only enough for 5 times but set to 6 times), the task will end directly.

Plans.name: Development plans
Plans.help:
JSON array, one action per item, same format as MAA "import plan from clipboard"
Example:
[
  {{"name": "艾雅法拉", "elite": 2}},
  {{"name": "艾雅法拉", "skill_level": 7}},
  {{"name": "史尔特尔", "skill_mastery": [3, 0, 0]}}
]

name: operator name (required)
elite: elite target, 1 or 2
skill_level: skill level target, 2~7
skill_mastery: mastery of the 3 skills, 0~3, e.g. [3, 0, 0]
An operator can have several items, executed in order; add "role" (e.g. "role": "Caster") when names collide across roles
Empty or [] means nothing to do
